GROWELL self-hosted OCR assets
=============================

These files are unchanged distribution assets from the exact npm versions
recorded in manifest.json. Images and recognized text are processed by the
browser worker. The application must supply every local path below; the upstream
default CDN paths are not used by this integration.

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 / Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
  License: Apache-2.0. Full licenses are in licenses/.
  The original distribution's bundled JavaScript license comments are preserved
  in tesseract.min.js.LICENSE.txt and worker.min.js.LICENSE.txt.

Korean and English models
  @tesseract.js-data/kor 1.0.0 / @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0
  Only 4.0.0_best_int/*.traineddata.gz is included, renamed into lang/.
  https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best
  The npm packaging metadata declares MIT, while the upstream trained-data
  repository distributes its models under Apache-2.0. Its full Apache license
  is retained in licenses/tessdata-APACHE-2.0.txt. Package wrapper code is not
  included in this asset directory.

Bundled browser dependencies
  regenerator-runtime, zlibjs, wasm-feature-detect, bmp-js, is-url, idb-keyval,
  base64-js, buffer, and ieee754. Their full license texts are in licenses/.
  Browser bundle comments also identify their copyright holders.

Compiled core dependencies
  Tesseract, Leptonica, libjpeg, giflib, libpng, libtiff, libwebp, openlibm,
  and zlib. Their original licenses, copyright notices, patent grant where
  provided, and licensing README files are retained in licenses/.
  Source commits and public license URLs are recorded in manifest.json.

Runtime paths and supported engine mode
  script:     /vendor/tesseract/tesseract.min.js
  workerPath: /vendor/tesseract/worker.min.js
  corePath:   /vendor/tesseract/core
  langPath:   /vendor/tesseract/lang
  createWorker(['kor', 'eng'], 1, {
    workerPath, corePath, langPath,
    workerBlobURL: false, gzip: true, legacyCore: false, legacyLang: false
  })

OEM 1 (LSTM only) is required. Tesseract.js selects one of the three supplied
core variants: base, SIMD, or relaxed SIMD. Each *.wasm.js contains its own
WebAssembly binary; separate *.wasm and ordinary *.js files would be redundant.
The embedded binaries were checked against the original npm .wasm binaries.
Legacy engine variants, legacy model data, and source maps are not distributed.
The engine, worker, selected core, and language files are loaded only when OCR
is requested. Browser caching of language assets does not store user images.

Integrity
  manifest.json lists byte sizes and SHA-256 digests for every asset and notice
  except the manifest itself. Exact npm tarball integrity values are preserved.
